Professional flat vector logo lockup for the brand "Brewlio".
The wordmark text must read exactly "Brewlio" — spelled letter by letter, correctly, in a clean legible typeface. Render no other words, no lorem text, no watermark.
Logo archetype: wordmark mark.
Industry context: specialty coffee roastery.
Composition to adapt: As a Wordmark, the design relies 100% on custom stylized script typography. There is no external crest, shield, or icon; the words "Coca-Cola" are joined by an optical hyphen and anchored by elongated dynamic swashes extending from the uppercase letters 'C'.
Geometry: Balanced to Complex. Continuous calligraphic rhythm; the first 'C' features a sweeping lower swash that swoops under the "oca" syllable, while the second 'C' projects a soaring ribbon swash that loops over the "ola" syllable, establishing continuous horizontal momentum.
Typography direction: Spencerian Script Calligraphy (historic 19th-century American cursive handwriting). Flowing calligraphic weight with dramatic contrast between thick downstrokes and hair-thin upstrokes, continuous cursive ligatures, distinctive flourishing swooshes extending beneath and through the letterforms.
Archetype brief: A timeless vintage cursive wordmark logo for a world-famous beverage brand. The design features elegant, flowing Spencerian script typography reading 'Brewlio', with dramatic contrast between thick calligraphic strokes and delicate upstrokes, characterized by long sweeping ribbon swashes looping gracefully above and beneath the letters. Vibrant pure crimson red (#F40009) solid fill, flat 2D vector typography, isolated on a clean white or transparent background, perfect rhythmic kerning, nostalgic heritage elegance
Aesthetic cues: warm, rounded, friendly, rounded sans-serif.
Use this exact palette: #6F4E37, #C49E73.
Style: crisp uniform line weight, generous negative space, centered composition, high contrast, pure white background, print-ready logo artwork.
Do not include: bottles, glasses, bubbles, ice cubes, drop shadows, 3d gradients, icons, emblems, badges., photorealistic rendering, 3D bevels or glossy highlights, drop shadows or mockups, busy backgrounds or scenery, extra text or gibberish lettering, watermarks or signatures.
